regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and classified the graphical abstract as an aggregate current diazo-dithiane cascade map yielding conjugated dienes or cyclic allenes, not an experiment-specific run.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and cited prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Identified Oku/Terada ring expansion and Wang/Yucel allene/diene chemistry as cited prior literature. They are represented as literature examples and not promoted to current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The graphical abstract masks substituents and the introduction does not provide unique experiment-specific charges or outcomes.

regions.finding: Visually separated four cited literature arrows: Oku and Terada ring expansions, Wang's Au-catalyzed cyclic-allene synthesis, and Yucel's base-mediated conjugated-diene synthesis.
Classified the KOtBu/DMSO diazo-dithiane divergence to diene 3 or cyclic allene 4 as a general current scheme; concrete rows are elsewhere.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–8, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all eight optimization/control rows independently with the shared 1a/2a/base/solvent charges, row replacements/omission/temperature, H2O quench, isolated yields, N.R. outcomes, and prose observations including no conversion or decomposition.
Linked the text's 3a–3s and 4a–4i range/limitation statements to the individual Scheme 2/3 records on pages 3–4; no narrative duplicates were created.

unresolved: Table 1 omits reaction times, atmosphere, workup, purification, masses, and N.R. detection limits.
Scope precursor numbering and full experimental procedures are not printed in the main text.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2 reaction header, products 3a–3s, X-ray inset, caption, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all nineteen displayed rows separately, including 3k as ND rather than zero and 3l with CCDC 2427670. Shared 0.1/0.1/0.15 mmol, DMSO 2.0 mL, room-temperature H2O-quench conditions and isolated-yield basis were applied row-wise.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left scale-up and synthetic-utility prose
regions.finding: Linked the independent 3 mmol 3a scale-up and four 3a transformations shown on page 4. DIBAL-H dose/temperature, air for Raney-Ni, m-CPBA dose, and individual yields remain arrow-specific.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right TEMPO and deuterium-labeling prose
regions.finding: Linked one TEMPO control and three distinct isotope experiments to Scheme 5 on page 5. Starting/product D percentages and quench/solvent identities remain experiment-specific.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits times, atmospheres, workups, purifications, masses, and explicit row precursor numbers.
Mechanistic controls omit absolute charges and most operational details.

regions.region: page 4 upper Scheme 3 reaction header, products 4a–4i, caption, and footnote
regions.finding: Recorded all nine cyclic-allene scope rows with shared 0.1/0.1/0.15 mmol, DMSO 2.0 mL, room-temperature electrophile-trapping conditions and isolated yields. The exact methoxymethyl halide for 4i is not named and remains unresolved.
Recorded the distinct 3.0 mmol 1a plus 3.0 mmol 2a scale-up to 3a in 80%; unprinted KOtBu/DMSO charges were not inferred.
Recorded four distinct 3a transformations: DIBAL-H 4 equiv/0 °C to 5a, DIBAL-H 2 equiv/−78 °C to 5b, Raney-Ni under air to 5c, and m-CPBA 1.2 equiv to 5d, each with its own product yield.
Classified the A–G sequence continued in Scheme 6 as a proposed anionic mechanism rather than experimental preparations.

unresolved: Scheme 3/4 omit reaction times, workups, purifications, masses, and several temperatures/solvents for derivatizations.
The 4i electrophile identity is not named in the main-text example list.

regions.finding: Recorded the independent 1a/2a/KOtBu/TEMPO/DMSO control giving 3a in 88%; TEMPO is an explicit reagent and the text states it had no effect.
Recorded three independent experiments: D-1a 97% D/H2O gives D-3a1 with 9% vinylic D; 1a/D2O gives D-3a2 with 96% D; and 1a/DMSO-d6/H2O gives D-3a3 with 6% D.
Recorded one proposed A–G anion-relay/1,3-sulfur-rearrangement mechanism with divergent H2O or R-X trapping. Intermediates are not isolated preparations.
The conclusion adds no experiment. The publisher advertises online Supporting Information, but workspace source mapping explicitly leaves association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.

unresolved: Control/labeling quantities, times, temperatures, workups, product yields/masses, and D-incorporation analytical bases are not printed.
The online SI statement does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.finding: The page lists the kinds of online SI and assigns deposition 2427670 to 3l. The CCDC statement enriches the existing 3l scope record only; it is not a reaction or workspace SI association.
